page.layout: One full-page engraving, no printed text blocks. Within the image: small inscriptions "Egmont", "Horn" and "N° 2." (the plate number). No columns, no margins with text.
page.notes: Copperplate engraving of a public execution scene in a city square: a scaffold with a block, a kneeling prisoner attended by an executioner, a wooden scaffold structure in the centre, crowds of pikemen and mounted soldiers on both sides, and buildings with arcades in the background. Labels inside the image read "Egmondt" (written vertically along the cloth at left-centre), "Horn" (above the kneeling figures), and "N° 2." in the lower centre. No running text, page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
